title: Port scripts/seed-target.sh into susi workflow seed-target
goal: A worktree's own cargo target is seeded, stripped and locked by Rust (susi workflow seed-target, with --background and --refresh) through std::process::Command: git, robocopy on Windows with its 0-7 success codes and /XJ, cp -a --reflink=auto elsewhere, tasklist for Windows pid liveness; junction and symlink removal, the mkdir-pid lock, SUSI_NO_SEED, waiting for a copy in progress and never failing the caller all survive; scripts/seed-target.sh is a stub that execs susi so branches cut before the port keep working; tests/worktree_target_dir.rs pins the Rust behaviour and a Windows test runs with Git's usr/bin off PATH
